calc_metric: calculate a registered metric like fid50k_full by passing metric name and kwargs to calc_metric
report_metric: report metric results to a JSONL file in the run directory with snapshot path and timestamp
register_metric: register a new callable metric function into the metric dictionary using the register_metric decorator
list_valid_metrics: list all registered metric names by calling list_valid_metrics to see available evaluation metrics
is_valid_metric: check if a metric name is valid by calling is_valid_metric with the metric name string
